The Daily Brief¶

The Daily Brief is a Django newsroom platform for independent journalists, publishers, editors, and readers. It supports role-based publishing, editorial approval, subscriptions, newsletters, email distribution, and a REST API.

This documentation covers local setup, the application’s structure, API routes, and the Python modules that implement the project. Build the HTML site from the project root with:

.venv/Scripts/sphinx-build -b html docs docs/_build/html

The generated site is stored in docs/_build/html and is included in the repository for convenient browsing.
